segments.name: Life insurance
segments.description: Runs a digital platform where consumers apply for and buy insurance and related products, directly or through third parties.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment, which has been identified based on how the chief operating decision maker (CODM), manages the business, makes operating decisions and evaluates operating performance.

revenueModel.text: Insurance carriers pay Ethos commissions based on the annual premium of policies activated through its platform.
revenueModel.evidence: Commissions: The compensation paid by a carrier to us for an activated policy.
